description: This file defines internal constants and a generic class 'Interner<TKey, TValue>' implementing a weakly-referenced object cache with periodic cleanup, intended for optimizing memory usage and reducing garbage collection overhead in applications that intern frequently used objects.

classes.name: InternerConstants
classes.description: Defines cache size constants for use in the Interner class.

classes.name: Interner<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Provides a weakly-referenced cache of interned objects, with methods to find or create objects, and periodic cleanup to remove collected references.

methods.name: Interner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with specified initial size, setting up cache cleanup timer.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a cached object by key, or creates and caches a new one if none exists or previous was collected.

methods.name: FindOrCreate<TState>
methods.description: Overload of FindOrCreate that accepts a state parameter for object creation.

methods.name: InternCacheCleanupTimerCallback
methods.description: Periodically invoked to remove entries with colleted targets from the cache.
